name: sales-conversations-skeleton
description: First evaluation set for the AI sales assistant (12 scenarios). The full 100-scenario suite is Phase 8; this file fixes the format. A scenario passes only if EVERY expectation holds.

knowledge.title: Plans and pricing
knowledge.content:
# Plans

The Standard plan costs 500 USD per month and includes attendance, fee collection and report cards for up to 1000 students. Annual billing is 5,400 USD.

The Premium plan costs 900 USD per month and adds a parent mobile app and transport tracking for unlimited students.

knowledge.title: Demos and trials
knowledge.content: Demos are free of charge and last 30 minutes. Our sales team arranges demos on weekdays between 9am and 5pm Pakistan time. A 14 day trial is available on request after a demo.

knowledge.title: Integrations
knowledge.content: The platform integrates with Google Classroom and Microsoft Teams. Fee payments can be collected through JazzCash and Easypaisa. Data is encrypted at rest and backed up nightly.
